title: Optimizing vaccine allocation in an age-structured SIR model
summary: We study an optimal control problem where the objective is to find the best vaccine allocation during an epidemic outbreak. The epidemic dynamics is described by an age-structured SIR model with nonlocal interactions. Both the infection and death rates depend on the age of the individuals, reflecting the effect of heterogeneities within the population. Our model includes a vaccination term, depending on time and age, which serves as a control function.
